title: Insert a freeze with an empty edit

definition.title: Insert a freeze with an empty edit
definition.source_excerpt: A second edit-list construction maps the first source second, inserts a one-second empty edit, then maps the second source second. Chrome holds the previous red image through the middle interval and resumes green after 2 s. The mdat is unchanged and the file grows only by the two additional edit records. At 8× Chrome reported 88 total frames for the ~2.967 s presentation, so this should be understood as metadata-directed timeline behavior, not a sparse-decode mechanism.
